paragraphs.en: Good morning, boys and girls! Welcome to our school.
paragraphs.cn: 早上好，同学们！欢迎来到我们学校。

paragraphs.en: Our school is big and beautiful. We have many classrooms.
paragraphs.cn: 我们的学校又大又漂亮。我们有很多教室。

paragraphs.en: Look, this is my classroom. It is clean and bright.
paragraphs.cn: 看，这是我的教室。它又干净又明亮。

paragraphs.en: I like my school. I like my teachers and friends.
paragraphs.cn: 我喜欢我的学校。我喜欢我的老师和朋友们。

paragraphs.en: Let's study together and have fun!
paragraphs.cn: 让我们一起学习，快乐成长！
